notes.text: The page continues with a map of spectra and corresponding maps of étale topoi and fundamental groupoids. The opening Spec stroke and the strokes in displays (1) and (3) are visibly blunt horizontal lines; only display (2) has a separable right head. Their literal forms are preserved without supplying arrowheads from the mathematical context.

The main paragraph describes a point of B_K-prime, a universal covering, or a separable closure, and describes a corresponding closure of K inside K-bar-prime. The six overworked raised marks are all retained with cancelled-prime/live-star alternatives. No relation between them is proved by their repetition, and no mathematical convention is used to settle their ink state.

The text asserts that the associated homomorphism of fundamental groups reconstructs the homomorphism of topoi as a restriction des scalaires. This global reconstruction assertion is transcribed as background; this reader did not prove it or identify the relative closure independently.

The final paragraph begins to identify the image of (3) as a closed subgroup corresponding to a subextension. The candidate extension is now explicitly doubtful at the physical right edge: e, a crossed x-like turn, tall t and low e/n/s contours are visible, but the final pale strokes are not fully separable. No descending g supports the independent categorie candidate. No continuation or terminal period is supplied. The literal E index there is K-bar/K without the six overworked marks found above.

Main-reader targeted proof check, actually reported in this run: for a group homomorphism h:E-prime to E and an E-action on X, define g-prime acting on x by h(g-prime) acting on x. The identity acts trivially because h(1)=1; the action law follows from h(g-prime k-prime)=h(g-prime)h(k-prime). This verifies only the action-level restriction construction behind the source phrase. It does not verify reconstruction of the étale morphism, identify the closure, or decide any written superscript.

The ink gives capital Topos in the opening, de groupes, and an explicit detached accent in réconstituer. The quoted phrase has paired elevated quotation strokes. Raised alg has no separate terminal point. The first sép. has a point but also lighter possible old alg. traces under the darker letters; the layer alternative remains doubtful. The second baseline abbreviation has no point and retains live sép/cancelled sép/cancelled alg alternatives. The accent in interprète remains uncertain.

All handwritten numbering was checked. The first display label is (1); the second remains (2|1); the third has a joined hump-shaped character with a separate right parenthesis, retained as (3)|3)|(n) without resolving by numeric sequence. The final prose reference reads (3). The separate dark margin upright remains 1/vertical-stroke doubtful. The lower pale folio is 3, with writer attribution left uncertain.

First-reading protocol: the original was displayed once for layout and each prepared half once for a line-by-line reading. Twenty-one principal text/formula baselines were read, with the interlinear additions and marginal marks inspected separately. All witness agreements, bars, primes, indices, punctuation and revision scopes were checked against the ink. Ten distinct evidence places produced ten initial PNG crops; one footer boundary completion was added to recover the full ascenders and the entire source right edge. All eleven canonical PNG versions were successfully displayed by reader_b and reported viewed by the main reader. The prior footer remains unchanged. No original or half was reopened; no OCR, web search, TeX compilation or blind second reading was performed. Canonical evidence PNGs, manifests and generators are retained.

H's editorial note about the second label and the superscripts is not source text. Macro names, bar/overline syntax and ordinary layout differences are excluded from material collation. Added certainty-only doubts in the second numeral, the opening parenthesis of the third label, and the state alternatives are recorded separately; the changes rows for disputed states record the actual C/H disagreement, not an invented resolution.

All eight unequal boxes of the ten-box frozen independent reading were adjudicated directly on their canonical crops. Eight existing helper crops were also viewed. The material reading changes are ainsi in the parenthesis and p with raised t in both point abbreviations; the latter has no written plural s in the deux sentence. Added uncertainty in the article, cancelled word, possible revision layers, accent, label and final edge word is recorded without additional material-change counts. Blunt map strokes, the one detached arrowhead and the unresolved six target clusters retain their local ink distinctions. Field-extension separators agree with the local near-upright/slanted habit on 149:003, without imposing a new operation.
